definitions.explanation: The act of cleaning one's teeth with a toothbrush.
The paste or gel used when brushing teeth.

examples.japanese: {毎日|まいにち}{朝|あさ}と{夜|よる}に{歯磨|はみが}きをする。
examples.english: I brush my teeth every morning and night.

examples.japanese: {歯磨|はみが}きを{買|か}い{忘|わす}れた。
{子供|こども}に{歯磨|はみが}きの{仕方|しかた}を{教|おし}えた。
examples.english: I taught my child how to brush their teeth.

examples.japanese: {歯磨|はみが}き{粉|こ}はどれがいい？
{食|た}べた{後|あと}は{歯磨|はみが}きをしましょう。
examples.english: Let's brush our teeth after eating.

examples.japanese: ミント{味|あじ}の{歯磨|はみが}きが{好|す}きだ。
{歯磨|はみが}きをしないと{虫歯|むしば}になるよ。
examples.english: If you don't brush your teeth, you'll get cavities.

examples.japanese: {歯磨|はみが}きのチューブが{空|から}になった。
{3分間|さんぷんかん}{歯磨|はみが}きをする。
examples.english: To brush teeth for three minutes.

examples.japanese: {歯磨|はみが}きを{少|すこ}し{出|だ}す。
examples.english: To squeeze out a little toothpaste.

notes:
COMPOUND: {歯|は} (tooth) + {磨|みが}く (to polish/brush)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {歯磨|はみが}きをする (to brush one's teeth)
- {歯磨|はみが}き{粉|こ} (toothpaste - more specific than {歯磨|はみが}き alone)
- {歯|は}ブラシ (toothbrush)

DUAL MEANING: {歯磨|はみが}き can mean both the action of brushing teeth and toothpaste itself, though {歯磨|はみが}き{粉|こ} is more explicitly 'toothpaste.'

RELATED:
- {歯|は} (tooth)
- {歯医者|はいしゃ} (dentist)
- {虫歯|むしば} (cavity, tooth decay)
